RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel and an unanswered request for feedback are valid indicators of potential implicit bias, particularly given your stronger academic credentials. However, departmental leadership roles often weigh executive management experience and interview performance more heavily than technical qualifications, which may legitimately explain the outcome.

It depends on your current objective. If you want constructive feedback or wish to protect professional relationships, do not raise gender composition now, as it risks prompting defensive silence. First, send a polite follow-up requesting your competency scores and selection rationale. Only consider raising panel diversity or potential bias if you uncover procedural violations, receive inadequate justification, or decide to pursue a formal grievance or equal opportunity inquiry.
